claims.finding: The shareholder meeting held on the print date 2026-08-31 was called to authorise the Board to effect one or more reverse share splits at an aggregate ratio anywhere in the range 1-for-2 to 1-for-1,000, an authorisation ceiling that is three orders of magnitude wider than a listing-compliance split needs and is the mechanical precondition for a recapitalisation that leaves existing holders with a rounding error.
claims.corpus_ref: filings.json accession 0001213900-26-090837 (6-K, accepted 2026-08-17T21:27:38Z); proxy text quoted verbatim in docs/80023e5bcfe49d8556026b7f0c2a4f33a34b4537.txt, message of 2026-08-21T09:49:41Z, referencing the notice published 2026-08-04
claims.why_not_priced: Exactly one participant in 90 captured messages read the filing (the 08-21 bearish post); the rest of the flow on the same days is 'buck by friday', 'buyout news possibly', 'Pt of today is over 5$'. The stock closed up at 0.50 on 08-26 after the proxy, and the 20-day run-in is +42%: if a 1-for-1,000 authorisation were priced, a $0.39 share would not be rallying into the vote on 45m-share sessions. The ratio range itself is in the 6-K body, not in any wire copy in this capture - there is no news item, preview or analyst note on GAUZ anywhere in the 26 captured items.
claims.independence: Different corpus source pointing the same way: the FY2025 annual report is still not filed - NT 20-F of 2026-04-30 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1781446/000121390026050201/ea0288190-nt20f_gauzy.htm) with no 20-F anywhere in the 400-day filings index, followed by a SEC STAFF ACTION entry on 2026-05-27.

claims.finding: The corpus shows the retail flow that is setting this $10m price reading the creditor process as debt relief - 'debt getting resolved today!! Then Sept 6', 'yeah debt settlement, clear skies ahead' - when the underlying 6-K is notice of creditor meetings on 2026-08-27 to vote on a proposed debt settlement with a court hearing on 2026-09-06, i.e. a court-supervised arrangement in which the creditors, not the shareholders, are being asked to approve the terms.
claims.why_not_priced: The mispricing is legible in the capture itself: the same document that reports the creditor meeting is being quoted as bullish, and the stock rose from 0.33 on 08-20 to 0.50 on 08-26 across the notice. A market pricing a debt-for-equity arrangement in a company whose equity is worth $10m against >$100m of annual revenue and an IPO raise of ~$300m would be marking the stub down, not up 42% in twenty days. There is no sell-side coverage in the capture (n_estimates = 2, consensus EPS null) to correct the read.
claims.independence: Points the same way as, and is chronologically bracketed by, the reverse-split authorisation above; but note both findings are 6-K index entries whose bodies I could not open and whose content reaches me through the same stocktwits aggregate - treat them as one source cluster and count the larger residual only.
